articleTitle: FPGA Implementation of MAC Unit for Artificial Neural Network Accelerators
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Conference on Advances in Engineering Science and Technology (AEST)
abstract: In recent years, Neural Networks (NNs) have revolutionized business and daily life, it has entered many industrial applications, including Computer Vision and Healthcare. Software implementation of NN offers poor performance. Therefore, most real-time applications require hardware implementation. The main building block of the NN is a Multiply-Accumulate Operation (MAC). This article introduces design exploration and the FPGA implementation of parametrized floating point 64/32-bit MAC. In addition, the design of the multiplier has been improved to improve performance by building a tree of partial products. Therefore, the proposed 32-bit floating-point MAC unit has significant improvements 514 out of 32070 logic utilization with total pins around 98 out of 457 and a maximum frequency of 46.23MHz. Consequently, this study would have a major impact on developing and prototyping future efficient neural network hardware accelerators.

articleTitle: Areal-Time H.264/AVC Encoder & Decoder with Embedded Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Conference on Advances in Engineering Science and Technology (AEST)
abstract: In this paper, the exact solution to the delay in the encoding and decoding process of the H264/Advance Video Coding (AVC) and H265 video coding standard is proposed . An algorithm was found using the Inter Frame (Prediction Frame) (P-Frame) to make the standard called Embedded Algorithm that works to solve the delay of the encoding and decoding process of big data represented by High Definition (HD) in real time, and increase compress video ratio. It was proven through the application on many videos of different resolution and size, the efficiency and simplicity encoding and decoding is very good and there is no data loss in finding the exact solution to this problem.

articleTitle: Design, Realization, and Simulation of CMOS Active Inductors for RF Applications
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Conference on Advances in Engineering Science and Technology (AEST)
abstract: Many Radio frequency (RF) circuits such as low noise amplifier (LNA), voltage controlled oscillators (VCO), and RF filters need inductors for realization. Passive and spiral implementations of the inductors have many limitations, especially when these RF circuits are designed and realized as an integrated circuit. Standard structures realize active inductors that usually provide a limited inductor value and quality factor. This paper presents an alternative active Complementary Metal-Oxide Semiconductor (CMOS) realization, based on the use of the gyrator-c configuration that is suitable for the Integrated Circuit (IC) fabrication. Four CMOS active realizations are presented that include the basic realization, topology with feedback resistor, active MOS transistor feedback, and the voltage divider type structure. A comparative study between these realizations is performed to improve the active filter performance. The most important parameters that have to be investigated are the quality factor, range of inductors value at specified operating frequency, and the self-resonance frequency. It is shown that the use of passive feedback improves the active inductor performance, however, large passive resistance is required which is not suitable for the IC fabrication. An alternative MOS transistor and the voltage divider are used to replace the passive feedback resistor, so as to improve the performance without the need of a large chip area for fabrication. It is also shown that different transistor dimensions w1,w2,… and different current source values I1, I2 result in different performance parameters. Therefore, minimized transistors dimensions are required for the minimum chip area, and minimized current values are required to minimize the power consumption. It is shown that the voltage divider AI realization resulted in a significant improvement in inductance value (L=20.16 nH) and a higher quality factor (Q=3.069) as compared to other topologies.

articleTitle: Comparison of Different Types of Boost Converters with a Photovoltaic System
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Conference on Advances in Engineering Science and Technology (AEST)
abstract: Photovoltaics (PV) are excellent alternatives to fossil fuels. The power DC to DC converters are essential to the PV systems due to their ability to control and recognize the PV voltage at a desired level and shape. This paper presented a number of DC to DC converters (Conventional Boost Converter (CBC), Interleaved Boost Converter (IBC), Interleaved Boost with a Voltage Multiplier (IBCVM), and Interleaved Boost with a Switched Capacitor (IBCVSC)). All the converters are designed and modeled by using the MATLAB program. Four different scenarios are used to compare the converters and find out how they work when the switching frequency, load resistance, and input irradiation change. The finding shows that each converter has its own elegant features and selecting the appropriate converter depends on the load requirements (desired gain, ripple, frequency, efficiency, et al.). Furthermore, this research can be a reference to other studies while selecting the appropriate type of boost converter

articleTitle: The Bending Effect on the Parameters of Dual Bands 5G Microstrip Wearable Antenna
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Conference on Advances in Engineering Science and Technology (AEST)
abstract: Wearable antennas are commonly used due to their appealing features which make wireless communications and environments light, small, cheap, and flexible. This research investigates the design of dual-band antennas for wireless network applications and wearable antennas. The Rogers RT/duroid 5880™ was used as a substrate, which is simulated via the Computer Simulation Technology (CST) software simulation. The antenna is designed to work at a specific frequency of 6 and 28 GHz. In this design, a coupled aperture was used, which is an indirect method of feeding the patch. The return loss (S11) for the planar design was (-69.2 dB at 28 GHz and 23.2 dB at 6 GHz) for gain, directivity, and radiation efficiency. Next, the antenna was folded into a variable radius cylinder to study the effect of bending on the antenna. The selected radii of the cylinder are 5 mm, 10 mm, 15 mm, and 20 mm, and the folding results of the antenna were good and within acceptable limits, which means that the antenna can be used in wearable applications.

articleTitle: FPGA-Based Implementation of Polar Code Using Successive Cancelation Decoding
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Conference on Advances in Engineering Science and Technology (AEST)
abstract: The polar code has been chosen for the control channel in the 5G new radio (NR), because it can fix errors well, even at a low signal-to-noise power ratio. Its performance is found to get close to the Shannon limit for long frame lengths. This paper shows an FPGA (Kintex-7, Xilinx part number XC7K325T-2FFG900C) implementation of Polar codes that use the successive cancellation (SC) algorithm. The SC decoding algorithm of Polar Code is optimized to make it more practical. It is found that using fewer bits to represent the log-likelihood values (LLR) in the decoder has a significant effect on the used silicon area and throughput, without a significant effect on the performance. Different simulation tests are carried out over the Additive White Gaussian Noise (AWGN) channel to prove the effectiveness of the proposed scheme. The arbitrary-precision data types that Vivado High-Level Synthesis (HLS) offers are used instead of the more expensive float representation to reduce the latency and utilized resources. The results show a reduced latency of about 76% and a noticeable decrease in logic elements and DSP units (DSP48E) by about 50% and 86%, respectively. The hardware run of different polar coded systems with an arbitrary precision instead of float data type reveals a shallow degradation in performance.

articleTitle: A Comparison of Different Chest X-ray Datasets with Fast Pre-Trained CNN Models in the Detection of Covid-19 Infection
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Conference on Advances in Engineering Science and Technology (AEST)
abstract: It is difficult to construct an early and effective prediction system that helps to limit the current coronavirus disease pandemic from spreading. Combining X-rays and Artificial Intelligence (AI), particularly Convolutional Neural Networks (CNNs), accelerates the COVID-19 diagnosis. Nevertheless, choosing the optimal model and dataset from the many options available can be challenging. This paper presents the analysis and creation of a large dataset to improve precision and reduce errors in the classification, overfitting, and bias, so as to enhance generalization. The larger the training dataset, the better the model learns on a larger number of images, which enables it to discover and classify new X-ray images that have not been seen before. The number of layers in each model is used to compare computational complexity. Finally, this work presents a comprehensive performance analysis of five datasets. It highlights the use of transfer learning approaches based on four models, including ResNet50V2, NASNetMobile, MobileNetV2, and EfficientNetB0, and how the dataset size, image preprocessing, and overfitting affect the accuracy of COVID-19 case identification using Chest X-ray (CXR) images. The best average accuracy of 96.6% was obtained by the ResNet50V2 model across all five datasets.

articleTitle: A Green Nano-Chemical Dispersant/Inhibitor Design for Asphaltene in Crudes of Iraqi Oil-Fields
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Conference on Advances in Engineering Science and Technology (AEST)
abstract: Asphaltenes are a large and diverse family of molecules that can cause significant problems in the oil and gas industry. Nano inhibitors are an extremely effective way of controlling asphaltene deposition, and offer a number of benefits over traditional inhibitors. Asphaltene has shown to be problematic in flow assurance. throughout the life cycle of production of crude oil. This paper introduces the syntheses of a novel green nano chemical inhibitor as a base to overcome these challenges. The green Zinc Oxide NPs and green Copper oxide NPs have shown promising results. It was found that using ZnO and CuO NPs will greatly improve the asphaltene dispersion in crude by almost 23%, as compared to the commercially available inhibitors using ADT. This paper evaluates and compares between two synthesized nano fluids with a commercial chemical.

articleTitle: Influence of Different Parameters on the Electrocoagulation Process
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Conference on Advances in Engineering Science and Technology (AEST)
abstract: Heavy metal pollution is one of the dangerous environmental problems that are produced by various industries. These pollutants are difficult to remove from wastewater because of their distinct properties. Electro-coagulation (EC) is considered one of the most important methods to purify wastewater from these pollutants. The research aims to determine the effect of different parameters on pollutant removal. The present study simulates the non-isothermal EC process using the Computational Fluid Dynamic (CFD) model. This mathematical model uses a partial differential equation to simulate the process. COMSOL multi-physics 5.5 software is used to solve these equations. The heavy metal used in this study is lead (Pb) with an initial concentration of (1mol/m3). The effect of different parameters on this process has been studied, which are the applied voltage (1.5, 3, 6 and 10V), rotational anode speed (0, 10, 50 and 100 rpm), and Hydraulic Retention Time (HRT) (10, 20, 30 and 40 min). The isothermal process was studied to explain the effect of temperature on the process for two situations: isothermal and non-isothermal. The results show that the time needed to remove the entire lead (Pb) decreases with increased applied voltages and rotational anode speed to 50 rpm. However, the removal Pb efficiency decreases for more than 50 rpm rotational speed, because the coagulation produced during the process is dispersed at a high rotational speed. The HRT has relatively less effect on the process than applied voltage and rotational anode speed. The temperature effect is very slight within the research range.

articleTitle: Classification of CXR of COVID-19 Based on ICA Dimensionality Reduction
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Conference on Advances in Engineering Science and Technology (AEST)
abstract: The medical image data like chest x-ray (CXR) image tends to be more complex than traditional of other image data and needs dimensionality reduction. Whereas reducing the dimensions of the CXRs images should not affect the main characteristics, and maintain the same analytical results, therefore, reducing the dimensions is important in data pre-processing, to obtain faster time during the training process of the neural network and high accuracy results. In this paper, a CXRs images dimensional reduction method based on independent component analysis (ICA) is presented to Improve convolution neural network (CNN) Training Times, where the shorter training times give to allow for experimentation more with new datasets. Training and validation were performed on the datasets after Dimensionality Reduction through deep learning (DL) algorithms. The results demonstrate that the pre-processed dataset obtained after dimension reduction demonstrates the highest training rate and best accuracy in comparison with the original datasets. According to experimental findings, using ICA with the CNN method, which provides a solution for network training times. The results demonstrate that the proposed CNN method achieves up to 97% classification accuracy and out-performs other dimensionality reduction methods.

articleTitle: Design and Simulation of 30 GHz Micro-Electro-Mechanical Systems (MEMS) Resonators
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Conference on Advances in Engineering Science and Technology (AEST)
abstract: Wireless communication networks have grown at an exponential rate in recent years. This is primarily owing to the development of small-scale, high-performance devices. A resonator is a key component in many communication devices such as oscillators, duplexers, and filters. On-chip resonators that are based on microelectromechanical systems (MEMS) have demonstrated tremendous potential for a variety of applications in recent years. This is owing to their great characteristics that distinguished them from quartz crystal resonators, such as the CMOS IC technology integration, small size, high frequency-quality factor product, low power consumption, and low batch manufacturing cost. In this paper, a novel class of MEMS resonators is designed and simulated using MATLAB 2021b. The lithium niobate (LiNbO3) thin film has been used to achieve resonance frequencies of 30 GHz using the seventh order asymmetric (A7) Lamb-wave modes.

articleTitle: Multi-Stage Interconnection Networks Design Using the Quantum–Dot–Cellular Automata (QCA) Technology
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Conference on Advances in Engineering Science and Technology (AEST)
abstract: Electronic devices are evolving very fast and the demands for new features and new applications are increasing dramatically. Extra applications need extra components where the complementary metal-oxide-semiconductor (CMOS) Integration technology has reached its physical limits, Therefore, the researchers worked to find new technologies that fulfill these requirements and with fewer defects. The Quantum-dot Cellular Automata (QCA) technology is considered one of the promising techniques because of its low power consumption, small occupied area, and high operation frequency compared to the (CMOS) technology. In this research, the design of multistage interconnection networks (MINs), which is important in the routing process used in many digital processors, will be presented through QCA technology using a new switching element and new multiplexer. It will be examined for different architectures.

articleTitle: A New technique of High-Voltage Power Supply for Electrostatic Precipitator
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Conference on Advances in Engineering Science and Technology (AEST)
abstract: This paper explores and comprehends various power supplies developed for Electrostatic Precipitators (ESP). ESPs have been used to be a very active industrial device. The most valued part of their operation is the Power supplies. Thus, this review considers High-Voltage Power supplies' topologies and some of their features. Furthermore, it regards the qualities of High-Voltage (HV) sources. This work gives a study of several aspects of power supply characteristics. Thus, it is doable to mark the main issues in the ESP power supplies and the solutions to resolve them. Besides, it will identify the persistent problems. With all that, the work offers a possible solution without using the step-up Transformer in the converter as a New Technique to generate HV for ESP supplying purposes with lower THD at 44.53%.

articleTitle: A Comparison of Natural Language Understanding Platforms to Build Arabic Chatbots
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Conference on Advances in Engineering Science and Technology (AEST)
abstract: Chatbots are computer programs that serve as virtual assistants by conversing with users in their natural languages. Basically, every chatbot contains a Natural Language Understanding (NLU) component at its core . A lot of platforms for building chatbots are created recently with a variety of functionalities, capacities, and price schemes. Chatbot services are based on NLU engines which deal with sentences to recognize information such as entities and intents. Numerous NLU platforms are also recently made available to act like an NLU component for chatbots, however choosing the right NLU for Arabic chatbots is still an issue. In order to choose a suitable platform to develop an Arabic chatbot, the categorization, and core features of the most common conversational platforms that support Arabic language (Watson, LUIS, Pandora, RASA and Wit.ai), are highlighted and compared in this paper. Among the studied platforms, the Wit.ai NLU platform is chosen as an equivelant, popular, and free available platform to be evaluated in terms of generating the structured language from the unstructured Arabic language. In the proposed model, the standard Arabic dialect is used for training and validation. A virtual bank customer service department from Al-Rasheed Bank in Mosul is presented as a knowledge base. In the phase of intent classification and entity extraction, Wit.ai proved to possess high values of precision and F1 score with 0.96 and 0.948, respectively.

articleTitle: Surveillance Door-Gates Authority Based Cloud Computing for Global
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Conference on Advances in Engineering Science and Technology (AEST)
abstract: The Internet of Things (IoT) has reached a golden age of explosive expansion in the modern era. In this system, the Raspberry Pi chip serves as the computer, while the Pi camera monitors a business gate. When a visitor wants to enter the business, he must first touch the bell button, which activates the algorithm. The camera then snaps his photo and sends it to the IoT center through email, which is sent directly to the cloud server. It is possible to control the door lock online. This technology makes it possible to save visitor evidence as a record in the event of an emergency. Here, those who are authorized to enter the company are only allowed by opening the gate and providing a voice message to those who are not allowed to enter indicating the reason after the image has been verified by the appropriate IOT center.

articleTitle: Enhancing the Spectral and Power Efficiencies by Combining MIMO and OFDM-SPM Schemes
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Conference on Advances in Engineering Science and Technology (AEST)
abstract: The demand for new technology to meet the requirements of the new generations such as 5G and 6G has increased. Significant efforts have been made by developers around the world to investigate a new technology to fulfill the requirements of the aforementioned generations, in terms of high data rate, high reliability, and little complexity. A new technology called "orthogonal frequency division multiplexing with subcarrier power modulation" (OFDM-SPM) has been studied in this paper, while combined with the "multiple-input multiple-output" (MIMO) system. This combination of the two wireless technologies provides more advantages and features, such as double spectral efficiency (SE), high-energy efficiency (EE), reduced transmission delay, and reduced complexity of the system. However, the system shows a degradation in the bit error rate (BER) as compared with the classical MIMO-OFDM system. In this paper, the system performance will be enhanced through power reallocation policies (PRPs) by utilizing the saved power of the system to improve the system efficiencies. The simulation results show an improvement in the BER and enhancement in the system throughput performance, making the system more suitable for future wireless applications.

articleTitle: Comparing the GFDM Transceiver System to OFDM
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Conference on Advances in Engineering Science and Technology (AEST)
abstract: Generalized Frequency Division Multiplexing (GFDM) is a generalized digital multicarrier transmitter and receiver system. Its non-orthogonal modulation technique is proposed for the next generations of wireless networks. The GFDM structure is based on a multi-branch multicarrier with a traditional filter bank, which gives high flexibility on the side of subcarrier and sub-symbol. This paper displays the structure of GFDM and presents a performance comparison between GFDM and OFDM in terms of BER with SNR and PSD with a normalized frequency. The comparison presents the leading of GFDM in PSD, indicating low Out Of Band (OOB) and lagging of BER values, as the BER of GFDM is 0.000435 at 20 dB and the roll-off factor =0.1. Meanwhile, the BER of OFDM is equal to zero. The degradation in BER results from the non-orthogonality and the effect of pulse shaping. However, the effect of the pulse filter provided an improvement in PSD.

articleTitle: Design of Intelligent Fractional-Order PID Controller based on Ant Colony Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Conference on Advances in Engineering Science and Technology (AEST)
abstract: The DC motor is often used in engineering, and the Fractional-Order Proportional-integral-derivative is often used to make the output more responsive. It is easy to use this controller and set it up. Practical swarm optimization is an example of a soft computing method that fine-tunes PID parameters, but these methods may not be enough because they start with random values. In this work, classical algorithms are used to get initialization values, which are then tuned by an intelligent soft computing technique called the Ants Colony Algorithm to get the best values. So, the classical methods are used to get the initialization values, and then these parameters are changed to get the best values. Finally, the classical methods are used to make sure that the final values are the best they can be. To tune a controller mentally, you need to be skilled and know a lot about the technology and how it works. In this work, the hybridization process is defined for modeling this controller and comparing it to another method to make sure that the suggested strategy works, as shown by the simulation results.

articleTitle: Design and Fabrication of a Low-Cost Actuated Hand Orthosis for Rehabilitating Paralyzed Patients
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Conference on Advances in Engineering Science and Technology (AEST)
abstract: This paper presents a new, portable, easy to operate, and low-cost wearable robotic methodology for finger rehabilitation. It is based on a simple mechanism to assist the bending and extending movements with variable speeds, and it commensurate with the disease severity of total or partial paralysis. The designed electro-mechanical robotic glove relies on the analysis of the biological structure and the physiological movement of each joint of the human fingers. The created robot is cable-driven equipped with a variable-speed programmed actuator for treating and training the fingers to be able to restore their original functions. The designed device demonstrated durable flexion and extension movements of all the fingers synchronously and individually with different patients. The results showed significant progress in restoring a higher percentage of the hand functions after several treatment times under a specific program. The fabricated device is distinguished from other current devices in that it has a simple and comfortable design and can work and move more freely and without the need for a therapist. In addition, it is lightweight and easy to wear/remove, and the cheap price makes it available to all patients. The fabricated prototype can restore natural motion and the brain's memory for full control of hand movement.

articleTitle: Design of a Special Coil for Copper Tubes Induction Brazing System
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Conference on Advances in Engineering Science and Technology (AEST)
abstract: In this study, modeling of the copper tubes brazing process is done to choose the best operating frequency using a complicated shape induction coil. To provide a thorough numerical simulation of this system, MATLAB computer package is intended to simulate the power supply composed of a resonant inverter loaded by a parallel tank circuit. Moreover, the Finite Element Method (FEM) is considered to tackle the induction coil simulation issue, by using the "ANSYS" computer package. There is a sequential coupling between the transient thermal analysis and the harmonic electromagnetic analysis is performed. The frequencies of 60, 75, and 90 kHz, are tested to choose the best operating frequency. This computer-aided algorithm used in the design of such systems as compared to the traditional trial-and-error, experience-dependent, design methods that result in an expensive and time-consuming design.

articleTitle: Performance Assessment of Underwater Optical Wireless Based on QPSK-OFDM
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Conference on Advances in Engineering Science and Technology (AEST)
abstract: Underwater Optical Wireless Communication (UOWC) can be considered as one of the most appropriate types of wireless communication in the aquatic environment, due to its high data rate, reasonable cost, and quick response times. Despite these advantages of OWC now, water absorption and scattering of light are considered the most important challenge facing this type of wireless communication. Most of the research revolves around improving the performance of this system. By using various configurations of Multi-Input-Multi-Output (MIMO), in addition to Direct Detection Optical Orthogonal Frequency Division Multiplexing (DD-OOFDM) with Quadrature Phase Shift Keying, it is possible to provide ideas for advancement that would help in the development of the underwater channel (UOWC) (QPSK). The suggested system can achieve a maximum communication link distance of 173 m for 1x1 SISO and 230 m for 8x8 MIMO, with a bit error rate equivalent to 10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">-8</sup> in clear water, 74 m for 1x1 SISO, and 101 m for 8x8 MIMO, with a bit error rate equivalent to 10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">-8</sup> in coastal water, and 18 m for 1x1 SISO and 21.1 m for 8x8 MIMO, with a bit error rate equivalent to 10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">-8</sup> in turbid water.

articleTitle: Design and Simulation of Optical Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Conference on Advances in Engineering Science and Technology (AEST)
abstract: As artificial neural networks (ANNs) continue to make strides in wide-ranging and diverse fields of technology, the search for more efficient hardware implementations beyond conventional electronics is gaining traction. In particular, optical implementations potentially offer extraordinary gains in terms of speed and reduced energy consumption. Scientists have concentrated on light, attempting to create neural network models in the optics field since the optical neural networks have apparent benefits including low power consumption, low latency, high balanced processing, high bandwidth, and increased speed. The optical neural network can significantly improve the performance of the required tasks by taking advantage of the characteristics. In this paper, we propose to train an optical neural network through nonlinear units by a saturable absorption (SA) to perform image classification tasks. The Neural networks are trained and tested with the help of the MNSIT dataset and EMNIST dataset after the successful completion of the code we get a system that can classify and process the images with an accuracy of 99.58 % in the MNIST dataset which is also supported by the graph. The backward propagating occurs using the back-propagation algorithm.

articleTitle: Design of Iintelligent Solar Tracking System by using FLC Sugeno Inference Style
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Conference on Advances in Engineering Science and Technology (AEST)
abstract: Solar energy is one of the most important sources of renewable and clean energy, so photovoltaic systems have been used in order to convert solar energy into electrical energy. In this paper, a smart dual-axis solar tracking system is proposed and designed based on the fuzzy logic controller (FLC) Sugeno inference style. Using MATLAB/Simulink simulation to design the fuzzy logic algorithm. The system consists of basic parts which are the Arduino microcontroller, two-DC motors and four LDR sensors. The work was tasted indoor with a light tracking response experiment, where the result showed high reliable performance of the tracking system and it was found a quick to respond, smooth movement and low error percent in LDR sensors calibration.

articleTitle: Study and Analysis of Fault Detection in Solar Array System Based on Internet of Things
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Conference on Advances in Engineering Science and Technology (AEST)
abstract: Recently, solar power represents one of the most stable and important renewable energy resources in our lives. Its importance increases every second because the planet will run out of fossil fuel in the near future. But sometimes uncertain fluctuations appear due to rain, dust, clouds, and heat, which prompts the issue of power supply interference. So, in the traditional way, the solar panels have to be checked from time to time to figure out if they still work correctly, and that could mean either the maintenance cost will be high, or there will be a loss in performance. That could be obvious in a solar system with a large number of panels. As a result, a better way to check the solar cells is needed to make the performance better, especially in the case of a large number of solar panels. In this paper, a solar system is implemented. It consists of an array of solar panels and photovoltaic parameters in each of them. The main purpose is to build a system that works on fault detection. This study depends on Smart Monitoring Device (SMD) sensors, which are connected to each PV panel. These sensors collect the measurements periodically and send them to an IoT central server in order to detect the faults and correct them as soon as possible. This greatly improves the efficiency of solar panels. The results showed that the PV framework of fault analysis affects the output of various voltage IoT sensors connected across the array, and shading causes net voltage and current reduction in the whole system.

articleTitle: Smart Home Automation System Using Cloud Computing Based Enhancement Security and Environment
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Conference on Advances in Engineering Science and Technology (AEST)
abstract: In this paper, a smart home automation system is proposed can detect any leakage of gases, smoke, and fires with a prior warning sent via the Telegram application to the owner. When any danger is detected, the ventilation fan will work immediately to reduce the amounts of gases. Another mechanism that achieves a suitable climate for the home and reduces energy consumption is by connecting heating and cooling devices to the motion sensor. A two-threshold value has been added to avoid the machines turning on and off continuously when the temperature fluctuates at a certain value, as will be clarified in this paper. Regarding the security aspect of the house, a sensor has been placed inside the house on doors and windows to detect any movement, and sends instant photos of the place to the cloud and alerts via Telegram at the same time. These sensors are also connected to a microcontroller, which transmits data and values that will be processed, stored, and displayed in fog computing via a user interface, and then over Wi-Fi to the cloud. The time of sending data from the sensors to the graphical user interface (GUI) is instantaneous, with one second between reading and another, while images are sent from the internal camera with a time of 30 milliseconds, which is the processing time only. The system has been implemented in practice with good results in terms of reading accuracy and response time.

articleTitle: Comparison between 3-level single phase NPC and SI-NPC Multilevel Inverter Based on PD PWM & POD PWM Techniques for Photovoltaic Applications
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Conference on Advances in Engineering Science and Technology (AEST)
abstract: In recent years, photovoltaic (PV) power generation systems are employing single phase transformerless (TRL) multilevel inverters with low leakage current and voltage stress of switches to reduce the total harmonic distortion and improve system efficiency, such as three-level Neutral Point Clamped (3L-NPC) inverter. However, the shoot through problem in the converter leg can affect its reliability. Therefore, a three-level split Inductor Neutral Point Clamped (3L-SI-NPC) inverter is introduced. This paper compares between the behavior of single phase 3L-NPC and 3L-SI-NPC under different carrier-based pulse width modulation (CB-PWM) techniques for PV system application. In this work, both converters are controlled by level shifted PWM strategies including, phase disposition (PD-PWM), phase opposition disposition (POD-PWM) and alternative phase opposition disposition (APOD-PWM). The performance of both converters is investigated using Matlab/Simulink environment. By comparing the converters behavior under both control strategies, the results show a better performance of single phase 3L-SI-NPC under PD-PWM due to its ability to overcome the shoot through problem, and the current total harmonic distortion is reduced from 26.16 % to 14.22 %. Moreover, the comparison shows that by adopting POD-PWM approach, a significant improvement in both converter behavior is achieved in terms of the ripple content in the DC and AC side voltage/current waveforms. In addition, the 3L-SI-NPC with POD-PWM control, provides a substantial reduction in the percentage total harmonic distortion (THD) with a value of 1.21% only. Therefore, the 3L-SI-NPC controlled by POD-PWM can be considered as better candidate for transformerless PV system.

Author Keywords: Three-level Split Phase Neutral Point Clamped (SI-NPC): Phase disposition PWM (PD-PWM)

articleTitle: Cloud Computing System Design for Improving and Control Central Air Conditioning
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Conference on Advances in Engineering Science and Technology (AEST)
abstract: All areas of life have steadily progressed towards a modern time, thanks to the quick development, deep application, and cooperation of new concepts and technology introduced by the Internet of Things (IOT) and cloud computing all over the world. These technologies have steadily made their way into the smart city industry. This study describes a cloud computing system for big businesses to optimize and control central air conditioning based on humidity and temperature. Cooling a group of rooms with a central air conditioning unit to regulate and monitor centralized cooling for large buildings, system primarily relies on weather data saved in the cloud. Because in this work does have any sensors and this building has a lot of space and many branches, the best decision is to manage the speed of the centralized cooling fan by using weather data that is updated in the cloud. When considering gigantic currents in buildings and control, the automatization of simple changes in cooling and humidity will cut expenses and minimize the probability of failure. This paper uses the C++ programming language to program the Arduino, as well as the temperature and humidity sensors. These sensors will feed the centralized cooling data to the cloud, where it can be monitored and controlled from any device, such as a smartphone, to meet the building's temperature and humidity requirements. The building's air conditioning system is an essential component of a comfortable and good environment for internal settings.

articleTitle: Recognizing of the A-Scan Image of a Buried Object Using a Deep Network
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Conference on Advances in Engineering Science and Technology (AEST)
abstract: There are various techniques for detecting buried objects underground, and ground penetrating radar (GPR) is a common non-destructive practical method used in the detection process. GPR uses the difference in dielectric properties between the buried object and its surroundings to locate the object. The basic operation of a GPR device is to transmit electromagnetic waves and receive the returned signal. Processing and interpretation of the received signal using GPR equipment is still a challenging task in terms of time consumption, cost, and effective accuracy. This research aims to study the performance of various deep neural network architectures for classifying different buried objects. This work consists of two parts, the first part is to use a simulation system (gprMax) to obtain a reflection signal. The second part is to process the input images using a deep learning network for analysis in four categories. The advantage of this procedure using a deep learning network is to improve efficiency and reduce the time required to locate and identify a buried object. The training progress results for all networks show that four networks (EfficientNet-b0, ResNet-18, Inception-ResNet-v2, and ResNet-101) have the highest validation accuracy of 87.5%. In comparison to these networks, ResNet-18 is more efficient as less time elapsed compared to other networks. The performance and validation accuracy can be improved by increasing the number of the input data and adjusted hyperparameters values of the training options.

articleTitle: Comparison of MPPT Techniques Using Metaheuristic Algorithms
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Conference on Advances in Engineering Science and Technology (AEST)
abstract: The power and output voltage (P-V) curve of a solar photovoltaic (PV) system is shown as one peak under a constant irradiance environment ratio, however, the curve often shows multi-peak nonlinear properties that are not useful under partial shade conditions (PSCs) caused by partial clouds, flocks of birds, dirt, etc. Then, the traditional methods of controlling and tracking the maximum power point (MPPT) and tracking of the maximum power point (MPP) obviously fail because they follow the first maximum point (local point), whether it is a peak or another. In this paper, the main MPPT technologies for PV systems are reviewed, divided into four types according to optimization principles, and the performance of MPPT technologies for PV systems under PSCs is compared. Finally, the PSO algorithm is considered the best among these algorithms for its speed of response, as it reached the state of stability and the maximum power point at the time 0.2 seconds and its high accuracy compared to the other types resulting from the low oscillation of 2.2 volts peak to peak and the least number of iterations to reach the maximum power point, ease of implementation and high flexibility in changing its parameters.

articleTitle: BER Enhancement of the OFDM System over the Rayleigh Fading Channel Using Exact Radial Basis Function Neural Networks
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Conference on Advances in Engineering Science and Technology (AEST)
abstract: This work improves the bit error rate (BER) performance of the quadrature amplitude modulation-orthogonal frequency division multiplexing (QAM-OFDM) over the multipath Rayleigh fading channel in the presence of additive white Gaussian noise (AWGN), using Exact Radial Basis Function Neural Networks (ERBF-NN). Multiple types of neural networks have been used for comparison, such as the Feed-Forward (FF-NN), Cascade-Forward Back-Propagation (CF-BP-NN), Generalized Regression (GR-NN) and the efficient design Radial Basis Function (RBF-NN). The proposed model depends on treating the wireless channel information as a black box that can be represented as an ERBF neural network. The transmitter symbols will be the training data for the network, and the output of the latter will be the OFDM received symbols. The network will be trained off-line on complex input data and complex output data after passing through the channel. Since the signal consists of a real part and an imaginary part, therefore the model consists of two inputs and two outputs. The trained network will be placed in the system on-line to cover the lost and distorted data in the carrier channel. Significant results are obtained and compared with other methods. It can be seen that the proposed ERBF-NN achieved a high gain (reaching to 17 dB), as compared to other types of NN methods over different values of BER.

articleTitle: Brain Tumor Detection in MRI Images Using Histogram of Oriented Gradient Features
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Conference on Advances in Engineering Science and Technology (AEST)
abstract: Brain tumors are one of the leading causes of death in cancer patients. Early and accurate diagnosis of brain tumors is critical to the treatment's success. New technologies that improve neurosurgery success rates and reduce complications are constantly being developed. One of the most common methods for examining brain tumor images is magnetic resonance imaging (MRI). A new algorithm for tumor detection in MRI images based on Histogram of Oriented Gradient (HOG) features is proposed in this paper. These features are extracted from each MRI slice and then classified as tumor or non-tumor images using three types of classifier models, Support Vector Machine (SVM), K-Nearest Neighbor (KNN), and Artificial Neural Network (ANN). The experimental results that were applied to a large Database, show the effectiveness of the proposed algorithm. The accuracy obtained by the three classifiers’ models is 98.7%, %, 97.5 %, and 99.7 % for the SVM, KNN, and ANN models respectively. Finally, when compared to other algorithms, the achieved accuracy rate was found to be higher.

articleTitle: Triple Band Frequency Reconfigurable mmWave Antenna Design for 5G Applications
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Conference on Advances in Engineering Science and Technology (AEST)
abstract: As the need for fifth-generation (5G) technology continues to rise, a reconfigurable antenna has been developed in this work that operates in the millimeter-wave spectrum (23.5 GHz–29.64 GHz). This design is obtained by merging a half circle radius of 3.97 mm, and a half ring outer radius of 4 mm with a width of 0.255. The shape is similar to the round bottom flask. Two PIN diodes are used in this design to achieve frequency reconfigurability and various radiation patterns, to meet the wideband mobile communication need of the future 5G. Rogers RT 5880, with a thickness of 0.787 mm and properties of relative permittivity εᵣ = 2.2 and loss tangent (tan(δ)) = 0.0009, has been used as the antenna substrate. The small antenna element has an excellent end-fire radiation pattern in the desired frequency bands. The antenna shows three reconfigurable bands while offering good bandwidth, return loss, and gain performance. The suggested antenna is suitable for future (5G) networks because of its small overall size (9.8 × 13× 0.787 mm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</sup>), wide bandwidth, and frequency reconfigurability.

articleTitle: Capacity Evaluation of κ – μ Shadowed Fading with Various Adaptive Power Transmission Policies
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Conference on Advances in Engineering Science and Technology (AEST)
abstract: In this paper, the average channel capacity (ACC) of the κ – μ shadowed fading model with various adaptive power transmission policies is analysed. In particular, the expressions of the ACC with optimum rate adaptation (ORA), optimum power and rate adaptation (OPRA), channel inversion and fixed rate (CIFR), and truncated inversion and fixed rate (TIFR) transmission policies are provided. In addition, for each policy, the simple, mathematically tractable expressions of the ACC are derived by assuming that both of the fading parameters μ and m that represent the number of the multipath clusters and shadowing severity index, respectively, are integer values. Accordingly, clearer insights into the impact of κ, μ, and m on the behaviour of the ACC are obtained. Moreover, to gain further insight into the impact of the parameters of the channel on the performance of the ACC, the asymptotic expressions at the high average signal-to-noise (SNR) regime are given. The validation of the proposed analysis is verified by comparing the numerical results with the Monte Carlo simulations, as well as some particular models of the κ – μ shadowed fading for different communications scenarios.

articleTitle: Modeling the Effect of Operation Variables on Copper Ions Removal by Electrocoagulation
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Conference on Advances in Engineering Science and Technology (AEST)
abstract: Water pollution can be defined as the contamination of a stream, river, lake, ocean or any other stretch of water, depleting water quality and making it toxic for the environment and humans. The environmental effects of water pollution primarily involve the damage that pollution does to the surrounding ecosystem. Many of the organisms that depend on a supply of relatively healthy water will die. This work investigates the removal of copper ions from simulated wastewater by electrocoagulation EC, in which the impact of initial copper concentration, initial pH solution, and the temperature was made. These investigations used the Box-Behnken experimental design (BBD), combined with response surface methodology RSM. The results show that the removal efficiency ranged between 26 and 97%; optimum conditions for the highest removal efficiency are 99.37% at 56 °C, 3 and 200 ppm for temperature, initial pH solution, and initial copper concentration, respectively. According to the analysis of variance ANOVA, the correlation coefficient R2 is 99.1%, proving that the experimental data and model predictions agreed well via high adj. R2 (97.48%).

articleTitle: Optimal Short-Time Fourier Transform's Parameters and Gaussian window for Enhancing Signal Separation
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Conference on Advances in Engineering Science and Technology (AEST)
abstract: The observation of dynamic systems is essential in many fields in signal separation. Many algorithms are used to estimate this dynamic system, consequently, estimating and recognizing its dynamic parts. Short-Time Fourier transform (STFT) is one of these algorithms. This paper presents optimized STFT parameters to extract the Doppler properties of that system. The gradient descent optimization approach, Adaptive Movement Estimation (ADAM), is used. It is simple and fasts than the other to achieve the best solution. A Gaussian window has been selected to be used, while, the improvement reached 7-11% against the unoptimized process, and the processing speed was also affected by 35%.

articleTitle: Urine Color Analysis Using Random Forest Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Conference on Advances in Engineering Science and Technology (AEST)
abstract: Urine color is an indicator of health status, and any changes in urine color might be a symptom of a significant underlying ailment. To get better assistance for urine color detection and to overcome impaired color discrimination by the naked eye, a urine color automatic identification has been developed by using image processing and machine learning based on the Random Forest (RF) algorithm. The proposed system uses a web camera to capture images, analyze them, and then compare them with the dataset learned by using the RF algorithm to detect and classify the color of urine and present the results via Graphical User Interface (GUI). In addition, the proposed system can send the results to the cell phone of the care provider by using an Arduino microcontroller and GSM module. The results showed that the proposed system has high accuracy in detecting urine color under different light conditions, low cost, and it is easy to implement.

articleTitle: Detecting Important Video Shots Using Video Summarization and Feature Extraction Techniques
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Conference on Advances in Engineering Science and Technology (AEST)
abstract: Video Shot Detection is one of the techniques used in detecting changes in video scenes. Shots can be defined as the fundamental units of analyzing video files in a variety of applications, including online advertisements and e-commerce. The important shot determines how much a shot influences the video analysis process. Because of their low substance, some video shots should be discarded in order to reduce video raw data, using the summarization technique. Video summarization provides frames that are of use in creating conceptual information about a certain video. The present work proposes the coordination of both concepts: shot detecting and video summarizing for obtaining better outcomes. Feature extraction is performed via the frames so as to draw a comparison with consecutive frames used in video shot detection. This process involves the use of histogram feature algorithm, Histogram of Oriented Gradients (HOG) and Expectation Maximization (EM), after which video summarization is performed to find the best frame shot using Euclidian distance between two neighboring frames. The shot frames obtained during video shot detection are used in the video summarizing process in order to find or detect the important shots in a video. The obtained results indicate that the method introduced in this work is robust and sufficient.

articleTitle: Monitoring and Smart Evaluation of COVID-19 Pandemic Patients Based on Internet of Things (IoT)
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Conference on Advances in Engineering Science and Technology (AEST)
abstract: A smart patient monitoring system based on the Internet of Things (IoT) was proposed in this paper that supports the health care unit, especially in light of the Covid-19 crisis. Health institutions suffer from many problems, such as the spread of infections among the health staff due to their direct communication with the patient, and the tremendous pressure on health institutions. These circumstances prompted to suggest a system that is capable of solving these problems and providing access to vital information such as body temperature, heartbeat and blood oxygen, as well as monitoring the recovery room such as temperature, humidity and gases by using wireless medical sensors. This data is transmitted to the computing cloud using wi-fi network, after which it is displayed on the Thing speak platform where doctors and nurses can monitor their patients remotely anywhere and anytime. The proposed system will use the machine learning algorithm and the hardware component (DHT11, MQ2, MAX30100 and MLX90614) sensors and the ESP NODE MCU microcontroller, which is programmed via the IDE software based on C language. The system achieved good results and a high accuracy with low energy consumption, according to the experiments' results.

articleTitle: Bandwidth Control for Compact UWB Band Antenna in Ultra-Wide Band Applications
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Conference on Advances in Engineering Science and Technology (AEST)
abstract: In this paper, a bandwidth control reconfigurable ultrawideband (UWB)/narrow band antenna is presented. The benefit behind this method is to control the operated band in different cases using a single antenna for both (UWB) and narrow band configurations, so as to provide the rejection of the unwanted signals through the antenna hardware. The proposed antenna consists of a monopole UWB antenna of overall dimensions of (30x30) mm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup>, with half an elliptical patch of (8, 10) mm radii, a triangle patch of (3) mm arms dimensions, and half an elliptical ground plane (GND) of (8, 15) mm radii with a small slit at the feeding gap of (3x3) mm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup>. The structure is designed with Rogers RT5880 and properties of 2.2 relative permittivity and 1.575 mm height. The designed antenna operates with two modes of operations, with an input reflection coefficient (S11 ≤ -10 dB). The first mode is the UWB mode with a frequency range from (3.34-15) GHz, and the other mode is the narrow band mode with two bands from (2.8-4.38) GHz and (5.95-15) GHz. The proposed antenna can change the mode of operation using an RF PIN diode switch of (1x1) mm between the half elliptical patch and the triangle patch. The proposed structure has some accepted performances like a maximum radiation efficiency of 92% and a maximum gain of 5.4 dBi. The proposed antenna can be easily fabricated.

articleTitle: Deep Learning Based Signal Detection In NOMA Systems: A Review
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Conference on Advances in Engineering Science and Technology (AEST)
abstract: This review examines the state-of-the-art techniques that utilize Deep Learning (DL) to decode non-Orthogonal multiple access signals (NOMA). NOMA achieves significant performance benefits in terms of system throughput and huge connectivity. NOMA has been regarded as a very viable contender for the Fifth Generation (5G) and future wireless communications technology. Users in NOMA have access to all subcarriers and are not separated from one another according to the orthogonality concept. In a NOMA transmission, packets from every user are superimposed to create a single signal or stream. In order to separate user data at the receiver, a more complex algorithm was needed because NOMA serves numerous users simultaneously at the same frequency, but with distinct power allocations. One of the tried-and-true NOMA detection strategies is the successive interface cancellation (SIC). Incoming packets are first sorted according to their channel quality or quality of service (QOS) requirements. Next, the user with the most stringent criteria is found, with the assumption that all other users are noise. Perfect channel state tracking is necessary for SIC-based approaches. Imperfect (SIC) causes error in channel estimation and signal detection. This paper addresses recent studies that use DL architectures rather than traditional detectors. A DL-based NOMA receiver is made to decode messages for numerous users in a single operation without explicitly estimating channels. Recurrent neural networks that can learn order dependency in sequence prediction tasks are known as Long Short-Term Memory (LSTM) networks. A challenging deep learning topic is LSTMs, which will be addressed in this work.

articleTitle: Design and Simulation of a Self-Test Technique for High Frequency MEMS Actuators
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Conference on Advances in Engineering Science and Technology (AEST)
abstract: In this research, an advanced self-test technique has been designed and simulated to be used in high frequency MEMS actuators. The self-test design model represents the work of the actuator with a resonant filter. The model operates on generating the required frequencies by entering the data that is related to the physical properties of the piezoelectric materials into the proposed system, and extracting the design values of the resistors, capacitors and equivalent inductors. The possibility of self-examination and correction for any change may occur in the extracted values considered in the design. In this exploration, the effects of percentage changes in the designed operating frequencies have been studied up on the values of the MEMS impedances parameters and vice versa. The proposed system was simulated and tested at a high traffic frequency of 10GHz, whereby the results showed a high accuracy of detecting and correcting the parameter changes, reaching 99%.

articleTitle: Improved Performance by Designing and Building a 1.92 Tbps ROF System Using DWDM with External Modulation and DCF
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Conference on Advances in Engineering Science and Technology (AEST)
abstract: Telecommunication technology is rapidly evolving, accompanied by an increase in service requirements such as higher bandwidth and service accessibility. Transferring data at high speeds and the system performance are second to none. DWDM (Dence Wavelength Division Multiplexing) can be used to meet these requirements, but it is not the only option. Long-distance transmission using DWDM systems often experiences signal degradation, which can degrade the system performance. An EDFA (Erbium-Doped Fiber Amplifier) can be used to overcome signal degradation. OptiSystem 18.0 is the DWDM link model used in this study, with a DWDM design that uses 48 channels at an average bit rate per channel of 40 Gbps. A channel spacing of 200 GHz was used. At a 50-km SMF (single-mode fiber) length, the system quality increased in terms of power and frequency spacing. With the EDFA amplifier, the linkage is 180 km long, 240 km long, and 300 km long. Changes in laser power of 10 dB were used in the study. According to the results of the analysis, power changes affect the performance of the system. DWDM with a laser power of 10 dB complies with the values of the standards for the Q factor (Quality Factor) and the BER Min Bit Error Rate parameters. The highest Q factor at a distance of 180 km is 47.008 and BER is 0 with a wavelength of 1498.213nm. The highest Q factor at a distance of 240 km is 28.19 and BER is 3.32092 * 10-175 and the wavelength is 1554.134nm. The highest Q factor at a distance of 300 km is 24.9, with BER equal to 3.66154 * 10-138, and the wavelength being 1565.495nm. According to this study, the higher the laser power used, the better the performance of the system.

articleTitle: A State-of-the-Art Survey and Taxonomy for Load Balancing Metrics in SDN Networks
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Conference on Advances in Engineering Science and Technology (AEST)
abstract: The Software Defined Network (SDN) architecture divides the network into control and data planes. The performance of SDNs is dependent on how traffic is distributed and raises many other challenges. Uneven distribution of the network's load, for instance, can significantly affect the SDN's overall performance. With SDN, forwarding decisions and network management has consolidated in a centralized location. These characteristics enable the development of procedures for controlling traffic using Load Balancing (LB). LB contains different categories such as (Classification, Algorithms, Techniques, and Metrics). In this perspective, we highlight using load balancing metrics (LBMetrics) in SDN networks. This paper provides a comprehensive state-of-the-art survey of LB-Metrics. It gives a thematic taxonomy of LB-Metrics in SDN, including 30 parameters with an explanation for each. Also, a comprehensive study of 41 research papers containing all metrics. This paper aims to know the most important parameters used to measure network performance quality when using load balancing in SDN. Finally, this research collected 30 different metrics and found that most results on SDN balancing use eight metrics as the most critical evaluation that are Throughput (10.6%), Overhead (10.6%), Degree of LB (9.7%), Latency (8.8%), Response Time (8.0%), Packet Loss Rate (6.2%), Resource Utilization (), Transaction Time (4.4%) and Others (37%).

articleTitle: An Experimental and Theoretical Investigation on the Micro Drilling of PMMA Samples
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Conference on Advances in Engineering Science and Technology (AEST)
abstract: Laser drilling on Poly Methyl Methacrylate (PMMA) samples has several uses in a variety of industries including sensors, microelectronics and medical devices. A continuous CO2 laser is utilized for micro-drilling PMMA samples. The design of experiments using Box Behnken Design (BBD) were applied to examine the impact of laser factors, such as power, exposure time, and focal plane position on the micro-drilling process to analyze the results using the statistical technique (ANOVA). Simulation of the drilling mechanism's temperature distribution was achieved by the COMSOL multi-physics software to conduct virtual experiments. This simulation accuracy was fit to predict the holes' geometry and offered results that favorably match with the experimental outputs. The numerical optimization was used to predict the ideal hole quality, whereby the ideal hole for PMMA sheet resulted is a full hole of 1mm, with a suitable diameter of 360µm, and a small HAZ of 60 µm.

articleTitle: Performance Analysis of WDM Coherent Optical OFDM Systems
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Conference on Advances in Engineering Science and Technology (AEST)
abstract: This paper aims to exhibit the transmission performance of the optical network by integrating the advantages of both the Orthogonal Frequency Division Multiplexing (OFDM) transmission technique and the Wavelength Division Multiplexed (WDM) system. This allows for an efficient use of the bandwidth with high data rating and extends the channel usability to transmit more information like video calls, gaming, and IPTV. The performance of the model is analyzed using different matrices like Q-factor and BER. The modulation scheme is tested for a vector modulation format, i.e. Quadrature Amplitude Modulation (QAM) using OFDM sub-carriers, where an orthogonal multiplexing scheme is used. Simulations are performed with the same parameter values common to both intensity modulation schemes. Using OFDM modulation technology, 4 and 8 WDM multiplexed channel systems are simulated at a 50 GHz channel spacing, with different distances, and variable laser power. In this work, the CO-OFDM system is studied with the aim of examining the effect of the PAPR on the system performance. In order to assess the performance of the system, electrical constellation diagrams and Q-factor are calculated.

articleTitle: Analysis of Switched Reluctance Motor based on RMXprt, Maxwell2D and Matlab
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Conference on Advances in Engineering Science and Technology (AEST)
abstract: This paper gives a performance analysis of a 4-phase, 550W, 8/6 poles, switched reluctance motor (SRM). RMXprt (analytical software) built with Maxwell 2D (finite element software) was used for the simulation and analysis of this motor. Since non-linear features of this kind of motor lead to complicating the analysis methodologies, so finite element analysis (FEA) was employed. Results of the motor such as efficiency, output power, output torque, inductance, phase current, induced voltage, and flux linkage, were determined by RMXprt. Maxwell2D software results of current and flux linkage were compared with Matlab/Simulink with an appropriate error rate.

articleTitle: Text Steganography in Images Using Turbo Code-Walsh Code Transforms
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Conference on Advances in Engineering Science and Technology (AEST)
abstract: Numerous methods, such as integration between steganography and cryptography, have been suggested to protect the privacy of information exchanged. Steganography systems have come to be recognized as a crucial method for enhancing information security by using multimedia to cover up sensitive information which includes information that is invisible to the human eye. In this paper, text was concealed within a digital image using Turbo code and Walsh-code algorithm, in order to result an electronic lung x-ray containing the diagnosis of the condition embedded inside the image. The algorithm was implemented using the MATLAB programming language. The new way is exposed to multi-image noise like Gaussian, slot and paper noise, and it is found that the proposed algorithm has PSNR, BER, RMS, MSE results for Gaussian equal to 84.871, 0.0003, 0.0525, and 0.0027 respectively. These results are considered very suitable as compared to no attack.

articleTitle: Automated Smart Home Based on Arduino Applications
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Conference on Advances in Engineering Science and Technology (AEST)
abstract: Integrating technology and services within a smart home can reduce the need for human intervention, increase security and energy efficiency. A smart home automation is used to do some frequently activities which are performed in daily living. It is developed to obtain an inviolable and comfortable environment to make a better quality of live and also to assist the needs of elderly and disabled in their homes. However, it remains an open issue due to the available difficulties such as network distance, signal interference, unfriendly user, increased cost and power consumption. In this paper, an automated smart home is designed that is used to monitor the home devises and support independent living of human. Simple sensor network and Bluetooth compatible with an Arduino microcontroller are used. Sensors and smart electronic devises are the physical components which are used as interaction with home objects. In addition, to efficiently control the home automation appliances and get alarms a smartphone with Android applications are used. Moreover, for security purposes, a global system mobile communication is implemented to decrease the possibilities of an intrusion. The home automation and security are divided into sections depending on the planning house so it can be scalable and improvable if the home plan is changed. Also, more than one way of controlling can be used either by smartphones with Web applications, or by humans themselves. It is shown that such wireless home automation system controlled by smartphone, especially for Android devices, have been successfully implemented either via Bluetooth technology or by using low-cost Wi-Fi modules for some sensors to upload their data quickly.

articleTitle: A New Technique for Key Generating Mechanism
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Conference on Advances in Engineering Science and Technology (AEST)
abstract: Much attention has been given to securing communication technologies and developing encryption techniques to achieve secure transmission and ensure data delivery. One of the most important transactions that add security to encryption techniques is the key, which prevents the attacker from knowing the messages and data sent and prevents them from being tampered with. This paper proposes a new method for generating encryption keys using a chemical technique called a Microfluidic technique. The technique is about a series of data that are entered and mixed to select a proper resulting element from these series, based on the presence of those elements in the Fibonacci series, as well as comparing the frequency of these elements to the frequency of the Fibonacci series. Finally, the required condition is that the final series must reach the required key and length. The proposed method reduces the chance of predictability of encryption keys, the complexity of key generation, and gives the required length in a softer manner than the traditional methods. The results show that there is no complexity in the proposed method of generating keys. In addition, the results showed that the generated keys are within the required length, which is 256 in the hexadecimal system, which means 1024 digits in the Binary system.

articleTitle: Assessment of Reliability Improvement and Power Loss Reduction Based on Reconfiguration and Optimal Capacitor Placement Techniques
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Conference on Advances in Engineering Science and Technology (AEST)
abstract: This work presented the modern and efficient Binary Salp Swarm Algorithm (BSSA) to enhance the reliability and power quality of Radial Distribution System (RDS) using Optimal Capacitor Placement (OCP) and Distribution System Reconfiguration (DSR) strategies. This study provides a new methodology and analysis for reliability assessment using multi-objective functions that reduce losses and enhance voltage profile. By using two different scenarios, the first is the individual Distribution System Reconfiguration (DSR) and the second method is individual optimal capacitor placement (OCP). These two scenarios are applied for a typical 33-bus IEEE RDS. The simulation results that obtained from Matlab software by using BSSA show superiority the OCP strategy compared to DSR strategy in improving all the power system reliability indices, voltage of buses in addition to percentage loss reduction 38.246% in OCP compared to 36.9381% in DSR.

articleTitle: Design and Implementation of Fire Alarm for Big City Based on Cloud Computing System
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Conference on Advances in Engineering Science and Technology (AEST)
abstract: In today world, smart cities with smart infrastructure are a fast-growing subject of study. Fires can occur in open regions, agricultural land, woods, offices, residences, and other places, resulting in severe resource loss. This proposed research demonstrates how to improve low-cost industrial and household safety systems by combining innovative design methodologies and enhancing (WSN) capabilities. Different types of sensors were employed in this investigation to ensure and offer precise solutions to the system. Cloud gateway is used for transferring the collected sensors information Smoke, humidity and temperature sensors are deployed for collection of environmental parameters. This wireless home safety system may be used by anybody due to the basic hardware circuit design. The means of informing users about the system was through a notification. From the sensors, the smartphone receives gas, flame, temperature, and humidity information. It will provide the coordinates of the fire when it detects that the data collected with control levels exceeds a predetermined threshold and uses Remote xy and a Telegram Bot to alert the home's owner and neighbors through a mobile device.

articleTitle: Progressive DCT Image Compression Based On Quad Tree Decomposition for WSN
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Conference on Advances in Engineering Science and Technology (AEST)
abstract: Wireless Sensor Networks (WSNs) have nodes with limited energy, limited processing power, and limited memory. In addition, they have low bandwidth and noisy communication channels. Therefore, image compression is very important for WSNs to reduce the time or the required bandwidth for transmitting the images. Progressive image compression is useful in WSNs because even when there is a cutoff in the transmitted data due to ending the battery lifetime or channel noise, the decoder can decompress the partially received data to obtain an acceptable image. Unfortunately, the progressive Discrete Cosine Transform (DCT) standard is unsuitable for WSNs because it uses the arithmetic coder or the Huffman coding that is very complex to implement. In this paper, we replace these coders with the Quad-Tree Decomposition (QTD) which has very low complexity. Unfortunately, most of the algorithms that use the QTD require lists to record the state of the image pixels and the quad-trees. These lists require an additional memory of about (2-3) of the image size. Therefore, it is not suitable for WSNs. In this research, we present the No List-QTD (NL-QTD) image compression algorithm that solves this memory constraint. It employs marker bits of an average memory of about 1/10 the image size instead of the lists to mark these states. The low complexity of the proposed NL-QTD also preserves the energy of the sensor's battery which in turn increases its lifetime. The simulation results show that the proposed method also has a higher Peak Signal-to-Noise Ratio (PSNR), and a higher Structural Similarity Index Measurement (SSIM), as compared with other related algorithms.

articleTitle: Enhancing the Spectrum Sensing Technique Based on Covariance Absolute Value Using Double Adaptive Thresholds
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Conference on Advances in Engineering Science and Technology (AEST)
abstract: A new wireless communication technique called cognitive radio deals with the issue of the unutilized spectrum. Cognitive users can continuously scan the permitted spectrum to look for empty areas. Spectrum sensing is an essential element of Cognitive Radio (CR) for the detection of licensed users. Due to the Signal to Noise Ratio (SNR), noise uncertainty in spectrum sensing would make the detection unreliable. In this paper, the Two Adaptive Threshold based on Covariance Absolute Values (TATCAV) is proposed to increase detection performance in the presence of noise uncertainty. According to the computer simulations using Matlab 2021b, the value of the probability of detection is Pd=92.7% as compared to the results of Two Thresholds based on Covariance Absolute Values (TTCAV) Pd = 79.9% at SNR=-18, noise uncertainty Nu =1.761dB, and using Quadrature Amplitude modulation (QAM). The misdetection probability for the proposed approach is Pm =7.2% under the same circumstances. According to the simulations, the proposed approach results are considerably better than the results of the two fixed threshold approach.

articleTitle: An Approach for Optimal Under Frequency Load Shedding for Iraqi Power Network
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Conference on Advances in Engineering Science and Technology (AEST)
abstract: Under-frequency load shedding (UFLS) has been implemented to get back the electrical system after a considerable outage. Based on the research of recent blackouts, voltage collapse and voltage-related issues are also major challenges in preserving system stability. As a result, both frequency and voltage must be considered in methods of load shedding. To calculate the quantity of shaded load and its optimal position, the research considered both aspects when building a load shedding plan. Voltage sensitivity is used to identify the amount of load to be shed from each bus and location. ZIP load model is implemented and for accurate results, a gravitational binary search optimization technique (BGSA) is utilized, and comparisons are made to demonstrate the efficacy of the proposed strategy. To test the validity of recommended attitudes, the Iraqi National 400 kV is tested. Newton-Raphson method is used to show voltage profile and total losses. The planned disturbances include the outage of a generator and of transmission line in multiple situations. The main goal compared with other published approaches is to reduce the buses to be shed and minimize the shedding amount.

articleTitle: Text Analysis Based on Natural Language Processing (NLP)
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Conference on Advances in Engineering Science and Technology (AEST)
abstract: In the modern era of information explosion, where there is enormous information including thousands and millions of texts loaded on the Internet of over 1.2 million terabytes, there are no accurate statistics on the size of texts within this huge amount of data. Given the multiplicity of websites on the Internet and the spread of social networking services like Twitter, for example, it is stated that about 6000 tweets are posted per second in the year 2019. This work aims to analyze these texts through resorting to artificial intelligence to help solve this problem. In this article, a review is presented on the latest concepts in the field of word processing, information extraction, and implementing an interface for text analysis using the C<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">++</sup> programming language and Visual Studio 2015 edition. A comparison is made between two articles in terms of the number of verbs, prepositions, article strength, number of letters, with the possibility of sorting the text into verbs, nouns, object, and adjectives, as will be displayed in the program interface.

articleTitle: Enhancing the Characteristics of the UWB Antenna Using Meta-Material and Slot
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Conference on Advances in Engineering Science and Technology (AEST)
abstract: In this paper, a new antenna is proposed for the ultra-wide band (UWB) in 5G applications of low band frequency regions (FR1) 3.4-9.4GHz, using the meta-materials (MTM). The proposed antenna was designed and simulated step by step using with Octagonal Split Ring Resonator (OSRR), wire, and slot, by means of the computer simulation technology (CST) microwave studio. The proposed antenna has dimensions of 25x23x1.6mm3, and the simulated frequency bandwidth covers the frequency range 3.4 GHz to 9.4 GHz with bandwidth improvement. The S-parameter of less than -10 dB has been found to compatible with the 5G requirements. The proposed antenna has been manufactured and tested by means of the vector network analyzer (VNA) device. A constructed prototype of the planned antenna demonstrated an exceptional agreement between the measurements and the simulation findings.

articleTitle: Design and Implementation Security System Based on RFID and Wi-Fi Camera
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Conference on Advances in Engineering Science and Technology (AEST)
