abstract: It is attractive for the developed world to naturally become an electronic data cloud that intelligent beings traditionally rely on digital technologies and low-cost microcontroller panels. Many institutes use modern technologies to naturally prefer familiar people into their inclusive workplace, starting from cautiously entering their cars and ending with them. Therefore, biological development establishments, own security and military institutions, and other private institutes have become safer and more reliable for allowing entry and difficult to penetrate by unauthorized vandals. The proposed system respectfully suggests access methods to radically improve defensively private security, forcibly making it easier for investigated people to invariably enter their driven cars without the specific need for traditional keys or private numbers via the use of an electronic Radio Frequency Identification (RAID) card and the servo motor with the modern addition of a Wi-Fi camera that captures images separately and uploads to the cloud, which merely allows the direct supervisor and those who with a more superior level than him to inevitably follow the completed work of the institution and its longtime employees directly through the cloud online.

articleTitle: Classification and Analysis of Modern Error Detection Techniques in WSN
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Conference on Advances in Engineering Science and Technology (AEST)
abstract: Recent developments in the field of micro-electromechanical systems, digital wireless, and electronics telecommunications have paved the way to the development of low-cost, economical and low-volume sensors that can monitor the unprotected environment in the form of multi-tasking, and perform telecommunication operations. These small sensors, which can perform activities such as data processing, sensing, and transmitting information, are the core of the idea of wireless sensor networks. In this paper, the scientific contribution is the evaluation of different error detection methods, so as to identify a new classification for integrating new defects. This paper has suggested to make a subjective examination of the most recent mistake location calculations. From this examination, a selection of a rundown of procedures are assessed regarding the amount. A number of aspects are addressed in this work, including the advantages, shortcomings, and future research ways for distinguishing mistakes in remote sensor systems.

articleTitle: Experimental Study of Material Removal Rate (MRR) in Electrochemical Drilling of Composite Material
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Conference on Advances in Engineering Science and Technology (AEST)
abstract: Matrix Metal Composites (MMCs) are used extensively in industry, automobiles, and nuclear power plants due to their excellent properties in terms of hardness and reinforcement of abrasive particles as compared to other alloys. As conventional process methods cannot be used here to produce solids, unconventional manufacturing methods are applied. The present work makes use of a non-traditional operation process, namely the Electrochemical Drilling process. This paper studies the manufacture of the metal matrix composite (Al with 10%Sic), and the effect of Electrochemical Drilling Parameters on the material removal rate (MRR) of the metal matrix composite that was synthesized. The parameters are the supported gap (G) with a value of (0.3, 0.4, 0.5), voltage (V) with rate (20, 30, 40), and electrolyte concentration (EC) with focus (15, 25, 35). The metal was created using the shaking casting technique, and the experiment was created using the Taguchi method. It was discovered that with a constant electrolyte content of 25 g/l, a gap of 0.5 mm, and a voltage of 40V, the best parametric combination for MRR could be attained.

articleTitle: Optimal Power Allocation Based on PSO for NOMA Capacity Maximization
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Conference on Advances in Engineering Science and Technology (AEST)
abstract: Due to the spectral efficiency required to support the rise in connected devices, Non-Orthogonal Multiple Access (NOMA) is now regarded as the most essential issue among the many multiple access approaches. This research investigates and studies the User Pairing (UP) and Power Allocation (PA) for a downlink NOMA system. To maximize the ergodic sum capacity of the NOMA system, an optimization problem will be formulated with several constraints that guarantee the performance of the NOMA system. To solve this non-convex problem, this work presents a NOMA power allocation technique based on the Particle Swarm Optimization (PSO). PSO is an intelligent algorithm that searches from a random solution to the best one iteratively. Moreover, this algorithm is very efficient for solving non-convex optimization problems. Initially, three UP scenarios were tested to find the best UP scheme that could be used, along with the proposed optimal PA algorithm. The simulation shows that the traditional Near Far Pairing (NFP) scheme a has better performance compared to the Uniform Channel Gain Difference (UCGD) and Near-Near Far-Far (NNFF) studied in literature, when the proposed algorithm is applied. At (40 dBm), the ergodic sum capacity of the proposed optimal NFP was about (80 bps/Hz) higher than UCGD, and about (71 bps/Hz) higher than NFP with fixed PA. It is obvious that the use of PSO can solve the problem efficiently and enhance the overall NOMA system.

articleTitle: An Investigation of Radio over Fiber (RoF) Communication System Technology: A Review
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Conference on Advances in Engineering Science and Technology (AEST)
abstract: Radio over Fiber (RoF) technology refers to the transmission of a Radio Frequency (RF) signal across a fiber optic cable after the light signal has been modified with the RF signal. A wireless transmitting network based on the RoF technology has been projected as a low-cost, highly reliable solution for meeting the ever-growing user bandwidth, and multimedia wireless service demands. In this review article, an impression is presented of the current research on RoF technology and its various applications. The review includes a comparison and discussion between digital radio over fiber (D-RoF) and analog radio over fiber (A-RoF), and shows the main applications of RoF technology. The crucial factors that determine the effectiveness of RoF technology rely on the application, the environment, the distance between the base station (BS) and the control station, and the millimeters-wave (mmWave) employed in the system. Sigma Delta Radio over Fiber (S-DRoF) may be a good contender for future mobile haul applications. By transmitting a sigma-delta modulated signal, it can maintain the low complexity of A-RoF and high immunity to RF signal impairments of D-RoF.

articleTitle: The Transfer Learning Models for Face Recognition: A Survey
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Conference on Advances in Engineering Science and Technology (AEST)
abstract: Facial recognition has many uses in marketing, biometric security, and healthcare. Facial recognition has emerged as the most attractive field of study among other biometrics, such as fingerprints, iris, and voice. Increasing safety and security, avoiding crime, minimizing human interaction, and even supporting medical efforts are just a few of the advantages that facial recognition technology provides for society. Several face recognition methods have been introduced, including Fisher faces, eigenvectors, and the local binary pattern graph (LBPH). Because of the low accuracy of these methods, a convolutional neural network is used because it has been proven through many experiments that it is the best among other algorithms in terms of accuracy and time. Computer-based face recognition is an established and trustworthy technology widely used in many access control settings. Transfer learning is critical for addressing the underlying problem of insufficient training data in machine learning. It moves knowledge from the source domain to the destination domain. This paper compares previous work using learning models with deep learning algorithms. This paper aims to explain why transfer learning is used to identify faces and to describe the characteristics and advantages of these transfer learning models, in addition to comparing the previous studies on face recognition and the algorithms used in devising the best methods to obtain high-accuracy results when recognizing the face.

articleTitle: Historical Review of Mobile Robots with Moving Arm
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Conference on Advances in Engineering Science and Technology (AEST)
abstract: The robotics industry has developed significantly in the last three decades due to the tremendous industrial development witnessed by factories and laboratories in various medical, military, service, and civil fields and device industries. This article reviews the most important and recent scientific studies, references, and literature that deal with controlling mobile robots with a moving arm. Several studies have been presented, especially those dealing with the mechanisms of control and controlling robots with a mobile arm, and the classification of controlling methods by mobile or self-programming. Various mobile robotics driving techniques, such as Wi-Fi, IoT, and microcontrollers, have been compared with their different advantages and applications.

articleTitle: Low Power Low Noise CMOS RF Amplifiers for Wireless Applications: A Review
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Conference on Advances in Engineering Science and Technology (AEST)
abstract: The desire for low power, low noise, broadband CMOS amplifiers using various topologies for wireless applications that has appeared over the last few years is presented in this review article. A significant component of contemporaneous wireless communication applications is the circuit design of very high-performance CMOS amplifiers. A variety of topologies, including active inductor topology, resistive feedback topology, common source cascaded topology, noise canceling technique, and current reused topology, can be used to construct low power, low noise GHz bandwidth CMOS amplifier systems. In this survey paper, the circuit design has presented the applications, problems, and current developments of broadband CMOS amplifiers, which have been updated to achieve a high-performance amplifier parameters. From this survey, the feedback, common gate amplifier, and inductive source degeneration are the commonly used topologies to perform the desired performance. The parameters considered are the noise, power, supply voltage, and the gain, by drawing comparisons between the various topologies. Inductive degeneration is one of the most effective strategies because it supplies a resistive component in the absence of a resistor during analysis. Thermal noise and power dissipation are decreased, based on the noise performance and input matching.

articleTitle: Enhancement Performance and Efficiency of Photovoltaic Systems based on MPPT Fractional Arithmetic Optimization Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Conference on Advances in Engineering Science and Technology (AEST)
abstract: The focus of this paper is photovoltaic (PV) systems. Conventional MPPT has a number of flaws, the most notable of which are its fixed step change, sluggish Response time, high ripple, and high oscillation due to its swing about its(MPP). In order to solve these issues, this research suggests using the fractional optimizer MPPT. The proposed Arithmetic Optimization Approach (AOA) is anew metaheuristic algorithm for optimizing the three parameters of the FPI controller. The simulation results demonstrate that the suggested MPPT is particularly effective in reaching the MPP under non-uniform conditions without overshoot, oscillation, and minute ripple, in contrast to conventional MPPT and several clever techniques in the literature studies. The planned Mppt's efficiency is 99.2% numerous outcomes from matlab simulations show the success of the suggested controllers at improving power quality.

articleTitle: IoT based Closed Loop Cooling System for Solar Panels
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Conference on Advances in Engineering Science and Technology (AEST)
abstract: The global demand for energy sources has increased owing to an increase in the world's total population census. Renewable energy is the best alternative to traditional energy sources in the years ahead. Solar energy is one of the best sources of renewable energy that has begun to be used in many countries of the world. Electrical power is produced from solar energy by solar panels. The production of electrical power by solar panels is reduced by high temperature. This is a problem facing solar power projects in many countries where the temperature is high. In this research, a closed water cooling model was designed for solar panels based on the technology of the Internet of Things. This model has proven its effectiveness and has managed to return approximately 40% of the loss of power and this ratio is considered influential if large-scale projects are established. Water cooling can be considered better than other methods suggested by researchers because its usefulness is not limited to cooling only. Water can clean the panels of accumulated dust and strange object, which is not possible in some other methods previously proposed.

articleTitle: Designing a Cloud Computing System to Improve Energy Consumption in University Buildings
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Conference on Advances in Engineering Science and Technology (AEST)
abstract: Cloud computing has developed many services that a person might need in their life, including safety, convenience, economy, and other services. In this research, a system that depends on cloud computing was designed and implemented to provide a specific service within the university, which is the ability to control, protect, and monitor the electrical appliances used. The Arduino app is used, including 6 electrical devices, some of which are based on sensors (temperature sensor and other motion sensors). Through a specific interface, the user can control the power consumption by turning off the unused devices. When the amount of current drawn or the amount of energy consumed is known, this system is set to 12 A if the quantity of current surpasses a particular limit. Low-power devices will be turned off, and then the current will be checked to ensure that it is below the limit. If so, the devices will remain on, and the condition will continue. The most important properties widely available for electrical appliances is protection. In this paper, the protection is represented if the voltage drops below 200 V or more than 230 V, whereby all electrical appliances will be turned off.

articleTitle: Enhanced Harris Hawks Optimization (EHHO) for Detecting COVID-19 Using Chest X-Ray
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Conference on Advances in Engineering Science and Technology (AEST)
abstract: The use of X-ray images is the most feasible method of virus detection since it became important to discover a means to reduce the number of infected cases after the widespread spread of the COVID-19 virus. In order to increase the classification accuracy, an enhanced Harris Hawk optimization technique is proposed in this study for the feature reduction of X-ray images. The improvement of an algorithm is based on two perspectives: the improvement of the basic HHO algorithm's fitness function, and the improvement of its escaping energy value. The suggested algorithm's performance was assessed using two datasets: one with 800 photos and the other with 9000 images, both utilizing the XGboost classifier. 20% of the dataset is used for testing, while 80% is used for training. The enhanced method achieved a classification accuracy score of 96% using the first dataset and 95% when using the second.

articleTitle: A General Overview of Retinal Lesion Detecting Devices
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Conference on Advances in Engineering Science and Technology (AEST)
abstract: Many diseases cause harm to the human eye. Diabetic retinopathy could be one of the eye diseases, and the essential blindness reason, the lesions in the eye cause blood vessels that lead for blindness. The examination of the retina help in reduces the effect of disease on eye. In addition, diabetic patients regularly have to take a digital image for Retina. Then they are evaluated by skilled, which takes a long time and costs a lot of money due to the vast diabetic population. Then they are evaluated by skilled, which takes a long time and costs a lot of money due to the vast diabetic population. So, this field of study is vital and has the benefit of introducing systems for detection to decrease in an automated way. This work provides a brief overview of algorithms and devices for detecting exudates in the retina in an automated way. A device is designed to aid the auto-detection and grading of these diseases since the computer can expedite the test and correct the diagnosis. Using ocular imaging equipment to implement active data acquisition, nowadays, digital fundus pictures and optical coherence tomography (OCT) images are diagnosed as Diabetic Retinopathy (DR). To attain sufficient image quality for clinical diagnosis, most of the presently available fundus cameras and optical OCT instruments require the assistance of a professional operator.

articleTitle: Predicting the Effect of COVID-19 on Physical Activity of Survivors Using GSO and Hybrid Intelligent Model
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Conference on Advances in Engineering Science and Technology (AEST)
abstract: Mild COVID-19 infection may take a long time to recover, especially when trying to return to exercise. Patients are left unsure of how, when, and if they should resume physical activity after COVID-19. Some people may have tried to resume normal exercise but were unable to, causing concern about returning to normal. In this work, a local dataset (questionnaire) was collected on recovered people, including age, gender, medical history, symptoms associated with infection, and information about their current physical activity. The data set was pre-processed and then entered into the feature selection algorithm (GSO) to get the best characteristics and then predict the impact of physical activity for people recovering from COVID-19 using two hybrid models: RF with the DT and RF with the LR. The results of performance measures showed that the hybrid model overcome on the traditional algorithms. This prediction helps people be more aware of the potential effects of their physical activity, so that they can be monitored and their health needs met quickly.

articleTitle: Partial Face Encryption Based on CAT Swarm Optimization
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Conference on Advances in Engineering Science and Technology (AEST)
abstract: Videos are vulnerable to file hacking and unauthorized sharing or data loss. Many protect unauthorized viewing of video material via video encryption. The encryption of people's faces is becoming increasingly important. The main aim of this work is to use a partial encryption to encrypt the human face, so as to enhance people's privacy. However, because the complete video encryption is time-consuming, the partial encryption is utilized for efficient and speedy encryption. This paper suggests a partial video encryption by encrypting only the edges in the face region of video frames. Light encryption techniques for video encryption are preferable to be utilized. Thus, the Salsa20 algorithm has been employed to encrypt the edges in faces. In contrast, the Viola-Jon algorithm has been used for face area identification, and the Cat Swarm Optimization (CSO) approach has been utilized for edge detection. The CSO and Canny edge detection operators are used in the edge detection procedure. For evaluation, the PSNR, MSE, correlation, UACI, NPCR, and entropy measurements have been utilized to evaluate the proposed work. In several assessment criteria, the suggested algorithm outperformed the Canny operators, according to the comparison results.

articleTitle: Vehicle Black Box Monitoring based ThingSpeak with Long Range Technology
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Conference on Advances in Engineering Science and Technology (AEST)
abstract: Automatic traffic violation fine recording systems play important role to decrease traffic rules violation and accidents, the traffic fine recorded according to traffic violation type and violation location. Manual traffic fine recording may cause false fine recordings. Systems developed to guarantee driver rights of such false traffic fines. Vehicle Black Box systems developed for recording variations in vehicles in order to minimize or analyze accidents. Other systems record traffic rules violations automatically and report them to traffic authority system. In this paper, a Vehicle Black Box developed for, safe driving and false traffic fine recordings issues with proofing the availability of a vehicle at traffic violation location with date and time stamps; the system based on Internet of Vehicles model with the utilization of Long Range wireless technology to transmit a vehicle acquired data to a base station. Vehicle-to-Infrastructure communication mode designed. Acquired data sent to an Internet of Things platform (ThingSpeak) to be stored, visualized and analyzed. Real time test done; Received Signal Strength Indicator value measured indicating the performance of LoRa signal propagation at 433MHz modulation in such environment. A correct location obtained and monitored on the ThingSpeak platform. We found that there is no any interference between two vehicles when getting the information from them, where each vehicle has its own code and send its data separately from the other.

articleTitle: Deep Learning Methods for Seizure Prediction by Evaluating EEG Signals
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Conference on Advances in Engineering Science and Technology (AEST)
abstract: Epilepsy is one of the most common central nervous system diseases. It is characterized by seizures between different periods of time and may endanger the patient's life if they are in a state of work or in a critical place or situation. Anticipating the coming of seizures is important in protecting the patient's life, as they will take some measures or take medications to reduce the risks or prevent the seizure from occurring. In this paper, two deep learning methods are suggested and evaluated; the first model is based on a Convolutional Neural Network (CNN), and the second model is based on Gated Recurrent Unit- Long Short-Term Memory (GRU-LSTM). The models are used in order to distinguish between the preictal state and interictal state, and then predict the onset of the seizure. The methods were based on patient comfort while using the device, using 5 electrodes of Electroencephalogram (EEG) signals and reducing the alert period to only 10 minutes before the onset of the seizure. Results of 90% in terms of accuracy and 90% in terms of sensitivity were obtained using the first model. In addition, 71% accuracy and 73% sensitivity were obtained using the second model. Finally, with respect to the second method by using the average voting technique, a portion of the EEG signal with a length of 2 minutes was used, and the obtained results were 74% accuracy, and 84% sensitivity.

articleTitle: Design and Implementation of a Smart Energy Theft Detection System Based on WSNs Technology
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Conference on Advances in Engineering Science and Technology (AEST)
abstract: Recently, the use of a smart energy theft detection system has been considered one of the most useful solutions to minimize the electrical energy theft (EETh) problem, which represents one of the major issues of nontechnical losses (NTL) in power systems. This paper aims to design and implement a smart energy theft detection system based on a wireless sensor network (WSN), represented by the Zigbee technology and power sensors, as they are easy to use with low power consumption. The main contribution of the proposed system is the ability to detect the EETh at the distribution line and identify the possible consumer energy meter that may be an illegal consumer, so as to locate the area at which the energy theft may happen wirelessly without depending on telecommunication companies or the internet. In order to check the high accuracy of the proposed system, the obtained results were compared with the standard meter. This work is implemented using simple, cheap components with a higher accuracy, security, and reliability in solving the EETh problem.

articleTitle: The Effect of Communication Link Quality on Navigation Schemes: A Review
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Conference on Advances in Engineering Science and Technology (AEST)
abstract: Sensor networks play a vital role in today's applications, including monitoring the environment, gathering surveillance, securing a home or factory, tracking targets, or tracking military personnel. Accordingly, a growing interest has been shown in building such a kind of network, characterized by mobility which plays a significant part in the application's execution. Combining mobile robotics with wireless sensor networks created the mobile sensors network. The mobility of sensor networks can improve the coverage of sensor data both spatially and temporally, as well as their robustness to dynamic environmental change. Additionally, communication is integral to such networks since measurements and commands are communicated wirelessly. Therefore, communication efficiency is affected by the surrounding environment and the noise generated by the sensor devices that make up the network. This paper provides an overview of mobile sensor networks and their applications, especially in navigation, where communication link problems affect network elements.

articleTitle: A Survey on Driver Behavior Detection-Based Internet of Vehicle: Issues, Challenges, Motivation and Recommendations
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Conference on Advances in Engineering Science and Technology (AEST)
abstract: Numerous academic studies and government publications concur that careless driving behaviors on the road are the primary contributor to accidents. Therefore, studying driver behavior is seen as being of great use in the design and development of Intelligent Transportation Systems (ITS). The rising number of traffic accidents is ascribed to irresponsible driving, inadequate preventative measures, as well as dependence on sluggish and ineffective support systems. There are multiple smartphone applications available to help drivers become better drivers. Recently, vehicles have gained access to the computational capacity of cloud servers to run machine learning (ML) algorithms owing to mobile cloud computing. In order to address issues that have not yet been addressed by previous studies, this study intends to analyze and carefully examine the literature in the driver behavior-based Internet of Vehicles (IoV) domain. Thus, the development of intelligent transportation systems' crucial behavior analysis is covered. Sensors utilized in investigations, the impact of thresholds on labelling procedures, data balance and classification accuracy, and the thresholds in recognizing driving styles are among the topics covered in the examined studies.

articleTitle: Intrusion Detection System Based on Machine Learning Techniques: A Survey
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Conference on Advances in Engineering Science and Technology (AEST)
abstract: The volume of network traffic data has become so big and complicated as a result of the development in Internet-based services that it is extremely difficult to process using typical data processing techniques. Due to the enormous and complicated nature of network traffic data, fast and effective cybersecurity intrusion detection is a highly difficult task. In order to detect hostile traffic as soon as feasible, a realistic cyber security intrusion detection system should be able to handle a huge volume of network traffic data as quickly as possible.This paper studies a classification-based intrusion detection algorithms based on Machine Learning for speedy and effective intrusion detection in huge network traffic, including Support Vector Machines (SVM), Random Forests(RF), Decision Trees(DT), Naïve Bayes (NB), Deep Neural Network (DNN), Extreme Gradient Boosting (XG Boost), Nondominated Sorting Genetic Algorithm (NSGA2), as well as Deep Belief Network (DBN) and artificial neural network(AI). It has been applied to ACTUAL TIME The KDD dataset, KDD Cup 99 dataset, NSL-KDD dataset, CICIDS-2017 dataset, CICIDS-2018 dataset, ISCX Dataset, CICAndMal2017 dataset and UNSW-NB15 to compare performance based on rating Intrusion detection systems which are assessed in terms of training time, prediction time, accuracy.

articleTitle: Biophysical Effect of EMR Emitted from 2.45 GHz Router on the Reproductive System of Male White Rats
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Conference on Advances in Engineering Science and Technology (AEST)
abstract: This study aims to determine the impact of exposure to microwave radiation on the male reproductive system of white rats at different power densities. The experiment involved twenty blub/c white rats of 2-3 months old in good health, weighing between 23 and 30 grams. After dividing the rats randomly into 4 groups of 5 rats each, the rats were exposed to 300, 400, and 700 microwatts/cm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup> (μW/cm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup>) for 7 hours a day, over a period of 80 days. Following exposure, testicles were collected from each male group, and an investigation was conducted on the sperm. The parameters used in this study are the number of sperm cells in epididymis, the percentage of living and dead sperm cells, and the percentage of normal and abnormal sperm cells, which were all recorded for the control group (without exposure) and the test groups that were subjected to different power densities, being 300, 400, and 700 μW/cm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup>, respectively. Based on the obtained results, the conclusion is drawn that long-term exposure to radiation via Wi-Fi-compatible communications or any other internet connection should be avoided, because it harms the reproductive system physiologically. As the use of the router is very similar to the intensity of the waves emitted by the power device on the Internet and has a biological effect on infecting the reproductive systems of rats, the advantages of this study demonstrate the impact of microwaves at low intensities, which are comparable to the measured intensities in tablets and mobile communication devices.

articleTitle: Cloud Computing Smart Metering for the Power Consumption of Houses
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Conference on Advances in Engineering Science and Technology (AEST)
abstract: Since electricity powers the majority of countries, conserving energy is essential to protect the environment. Thus, energy systems need to become smarter in order to save energy. However, a smart energy monitoring method is to establish the smart energy monitoring systems. Electricity energy meters, which are used to measure the amount of electricity used in homes and companies, are well known. Many people are concerned high electricity bills at the end of each month, leading them to track and check their energy meter. Therefore, an IoT-based complete project for an energy meter was created. In this project, a power meter circuit was created using an ESP32 Wi-Fi module to create a Smart Electricity Energy meter that not only sends an email with details about the power bill, but also allows the user to view the power usage at any time and from anywhere in the world. Here, the system serves as both a voltage sensor and a current sensor to measure the amount of power consumed at a given time.

articleTitle: Food Classification using Deep Learning Techniques
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Conference on Advances in Engineering Science and Technology (AEST)
abstract: Image recognition of real-world food plays an important role in the vast scope of applications. For example, food classification can estimate the gradients of any type of food to help diabetic and ill people to follow a healthy diet. Therefore, researchers have proposed methods and algorithms to recognize different types of food. However, the recognition process is a very challenging task due to the unlimited variations within the captured images of different kinds of food. Hence, we propose a new dataset which contains 20000 images of 15 different classes of local meals. A semi-automatic method is presented to provide the data annotations. The collected images are used to propose detector and recognizer models. The trained detector provides a detection rate of 81%. The train detector is designed by adopting YOLO v3-tiny. Additionally, the food classification process is performed based on two types of features: traditional features and learned ones. The results show the superiority of the deep learning features over the hand-craft features. Adopting the transfer learning techniques with the pre-trained model of Resnet50 achieves about 95% accuracy of classification rate.
